system.description:
Required Weapon: Fencing Swords A Castillian style that forgoes an off-hand weapon entirely. The duelist tucks one arm behind their back and narrows their profile, moving to an internal rhythm like a dance.

  • Aldana Ruse. After an enemy misses you, you may mark a Stress to make an attack roll. If it hits, roll a number of d6 equal to your Finesse modifier - minimum 1. You may add all the 6s rolled to your weapon damage.
  • Aldana Dance. You can mark a Stress when being hit to add your Charm to your Evasion. If this causes the attack to miss, your opponent becomes Vulnerable until they succed on a Reaction Roll (15) to redress themselves.
  • Aldana Precision. When you make an attack roll, you can mark a Stress to gain a bonus to the roll equal to your Wits.
